Nani's 'The Paradise' Receives Mixed Viewer Reactions, Earns Rs 50 Cr

Nani's film 'The Paradise' has garnered mixed reactions from first-day viewers, with some calling it an 'epic disaster' while others gave the actor a 'thumbs up'. The film reportedly earned Rs 50 crore, with some reports stating it created box office history for Nani hours before its premiere.
